optimized_sql:
WITH
d1_scope AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 4
      AND d_year = 1999
),
d2_scope AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10
      AND d_year = 1999
),
d3_scope AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10
      AND d_year = 1999
),
ss_scope AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        ss_customer_sk,
        ss_item_sk,
        ss_ticket_number,
        ss_store_sk,
        ss_net_profit
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN d1_scope
      ON d1_scope.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk
),
sr_scope AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        sr_customer_sk,
        sr_item_sk,
        sr_ticket_number,
        sr_net_loss
    FROM store_returns
    JOIN d2_scope
      ON d2_scope.d_date_sk = store_returns.sr_returned_date_sk
),
cs_scope AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        cs_bill_customer_sk,
        cs_item_sk,
        cs_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN d3_scope
      ON d3_scope.d_date_sk = catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk
)
SELECT
    item.i_item_id,
    item.i_item_desc,
    store.s_store_id,
    store.s_store_name,
    max(ss_scope.ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
    max(sr_scope.sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
    max(cs_scope.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM ss_scope
JOIN sr_scope
  ON ss_scope.ss_customer_sk = sr_scope.sr_customer_sk
 AND ss_scope.ss_item_sk = sr_scope.sr_item_sk
 AND ss_scope.ss_ticket_number = sr_scope.sr_ticket_number
JOIN cs_scope
  ON ss_scope.ss_customer_sk = cs_scope.cs_bill_customer_sk
 AND ss_scope.ss_item_sk = cs_scope.cs_item_sk
JOIN store
  ON store.s_store_sk = ss_scope.ss_store_sk
JOIN item
  ON item.i_item_sk = ss_scope.ss_item_sk
GROUP BY
    item.i_item_id,
    item.i_item_desc,
    store.s_store_id,
    store.s_store_name
ORDER BY
    item.i_item_id,
    item.i_item_desc,
    store.s_store_id,
    store.s_store_name
LIMIT 100
